Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4. Join drug_mechanism on molregno and filter action_type = 'BLOCKER'. Join target_dictionary on tid to get target ChEMBL ID and name. Join compound_structures on molregno to get canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
